newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Telekom shares down after 96 report.
newsitem.headline: German Telekom shares down after 96 report.

text.p: Shares in Deutsche Telekom AG dropped on Tuesday, partly correcting their surge of recent days, after the telecommunications giant released 1996 figures which dealers said matched expectations, but did not surprise.
"The numbers were fine, not at all bad but maybe not wonderfully good either," said a Frankfurt dealer.
"People are taking profits after yesterday, there's no more to it than that."

Telekom shares, which surged to an all-time high on Monday, notching up a five percent rise at their height, dropped 88 pfennigs, or two percent to 40.25 marks after 45 minutes of pre-bourse electronic trade.
The IBIS DAX index was up 0.2 percent at 3,600.23 points.
In a statement released before its annual news conference later today, Telekom posted group net profit of 1.8 billion marks and profit on ordinary activities was 6.6 billion marks.
It did not provide comparative figures, but is expected to do so later today.
